title: Session placement
summary: A test machine is a QA host reached only through its lease; it is never a launch target. When a mission installs Yoke on a test machine and connects it, the walker runs `yoke qa mission connected-machine` (add --test-machine for a declared companion) right after the connect step succeeds. It reads that host's $HOME/.yoke/config.json machine_id, verifies a live Machine registered on this control plane at or after the mission run began, records it on the mission docket as connected_machine and prints the machine_id with its launch hint; session launches pass that id to --machine. It refuses connected_machine_absent (the install never connected: no launch target), connected_machine_unregistered (connected to another Yoke) or connected_machine_predates_mission (not created by this mission), each with its recovery. walk-end records an unrecorded driver Machine before restore and retires only the docket's connected_machine, recording connected_machine_retirement in the fixture_project_disposal receipt; a Machine it may not retire stays live with the owner's `yoke machine retire <id> --confirm` recovery printed as connected_machine_not_retired.
